# Carps
Space carp are aggressive predators encountered on salvage expeditions. Most variants can fly and cross low obstacles.
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# Known variants # “Carp”
The basic expedition carp variant.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the creature hovers above the surface and can cross low obstacles.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health threshold:[/color][/bold] 50 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 6 [color=red]slashing[/color] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] none - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Flying
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# “Magicarp”
A rare variety of carp. No magic has been observed.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the creature hovers above the surface and can cross low obstacles.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health threshold:[/color][/bold] 40 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 5 [color=red]blunt[/color], 7 [color=red]slashing[/color] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] none - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Flying
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# “Holocarp”
A carp made of holographic energy. It certainly feels real.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the creature hovers above the surface and can cross low obstacles.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health threshold:[/color][/bold] 40 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 5 [color=red]blunt[/color], 7 [color=red]slashing[/color] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] none - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Flying, bullet immunity
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# “Rainbow carp”
A bright and dangerous variety of carp.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the creature hovers above the surface and can cross low obstacles.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health threshold:[/color][/bold] 40 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 5 [color=red]blunt[/color], 7 [color=red]slashing[/color] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] none - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Flying, beautiful
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# “Space dragon”
A large and extremely dangerous target associated with carp.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the creature hovers above the surface and can cross low obstacles.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health threshold:[/color][/bold] 200 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 12 [color=red]brute[/color] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] none - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Flying, weak projectile reflection
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# Mission objectives ## Elimination
Eliminate the large and dangerous [color=#a4885c]space dragon[/color] within the allotted time.
## Destruction
Destroy the required number of [color=#a4885c]carp statues[/color] within the allotted time.
